youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You #5 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each country slide to its real size 🌍 Did Argentina vs India get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: CIA World Factbook, total area (Norway 323,802 km²; Egypt 1,001,450; Saudi Arabia 2,149,690; Thailand 513,120; Sweden 450,295; Argentina 2,780,400; India 3,287,263) and US Census Bureau (Alaska 1,723,337 km²).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
